result.visual_intent: A simple bar chart of exact counts by method. Label the y axis Count, start at zero, and show the count above each bar. No uncertainty intervals or extra data.
result.target_plot_desc0:
A clean vertical bar chart showing exact counts for three methods.

- X-axis: categorical methods, ordered left to right as Method A, Method B, Method C.
- Y-axis: labeled “Count,” beginning at 0 and extending to approximately 21 to leave space for labels.
- Bars:
  - Method A: height 12
  - Method B: height 19
  - Method C: height 7
- Display the exact values “12”, “19”, and “7” centered above their respective bars.
- Use a single consistent fill color, such as HEX `#4C78A8`, with no hue grouping or legend.
- Bars should have moderate width with small, even gaps; no outlines or use a subtle dark outline (`#2F3E4E`) at 0.8 pt.
- Use a white or very light gray background (`#FFFFFF`), with horizontal gridlines only, colored `#D9D9D9`, thin and lightly dashed or solid.
- Set the y-axis lower limit exactly to 0; do not truncate the baseline.
- Use a readable sans-serif font: title, if included, 14 pt; axis labels 12 pt; tick labels and value annotations 10–11 pt.
- Remove the top and right plot spines; retain thin gray left and bottom spines.
- Do not include uncertainty intervals, error bars, connecting lines, extra annotations, or additional data.
result.target_plot_desc0_code:
```python
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

methods = ["Method A", "Method B", "Method C"]
counts = [12, 19, 7]

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 4), facecolor="#FFFFFF")
ax.set_facecolor("#FFFFFF")

bars = ax.bar(
    methods,
    counts,
    width=0.65,
    color="#4C78A8",
    edgecolor="#2F3E4E",
    linewidth=0.8,
)

ax.set_ylim(0, 21)
ax.set_ylabel("Count", fontsize=12)
ax.set_xlabel("")
ax.set_yticks(range(0, 21, 5))
ax.tick_params(axis="both", labelsize=10)

ax.yaxis.grid(
    True,
    color="#D9D9D9",
    linewidth=0.8,
    linestyle="--",
)
ax.xaxis.grid(False)
ax.set_axisbelow(True)

ax.spines["top"].set_visible(False)
ax.spines["right"].set_visible(False)
ax.spines["left"].set_color("#808080")
ax.spines["bottom"].set_color("#808080")
ax.spines["left"].set_linewidth(0.8)
ax.spines["bottom"].set_linewidth(0.8)

for bar, value in zip(bars, counts):
    ax.text(
        bar.get_x() + bar.get_width() / 2,
        value + 0.35,
        str(value),
        ha="center",
        va="bottom",
        fontsize=11,
    )

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
